//: Named layer states for pnpm test:golden, beyond each template's default state. Each lists layer paths to switch on (show) or off (hide); 'styleOn' switches a layer's whole layer style on. A state is compared with fixtures/local/golden/<template>.<state>.png when that file exists. The same lists are the instructions for producing that reference in Photoshop or Photopea. 'unverified' lists areas (x,y,w,h) left out of the comparison because the reference itself is in doubt there, each with the reason.

frame.about: A normal-size frame with a legendary crown and P/T box: exercises strokes, bevels, gradient overlays, a drop shadow, fill opacity, clipped soft-light and overlay layers, and vector masks.

white-legendary-creature.about: What Proxyshop switches on for a mono-white legendary creature.
